## 📋 Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature being addressed.

Fixes # (issue)

## 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Code refactoring

## 🧪 Testing Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles and runs locally without errors
- [ ] Verified on Python 3.10+
- [ ] Analysis pipeline finishes successfully on test APK
- [ ] Generated reports (HTML / JSON) render properly
- [ ] No personal credentials, API keys, or hardcoded sensitive paths included

Include screenshots before/after if relevant.
